title: Seeing Twice: How Side-by-Side T2I Comparison Changes Auditing Strategies
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The findings are related to how side-by-side comparisons change users' auditing strategies, helping them identify general patterns, cultural biases (e.g., Western vs. Asian styles), and racial biases, but not religious ones.
